$comment: Plan 170 D10/D11: Videorc's official Golem library. Edited by hand; the desktop catalog (apps/desktop/src/shared/golem-library.ts), the Rust bundled table and the web catalog (videorc-web lib/golem/official.ts, tests/fixtures/golem-official-catalog.json) must equal this file. `description` is what scripts/golem-official-generate.mjs asks the image model for; the Golem's art is the owner's original, so it has none.

avatars.name: Golem
avatars.personality: Calm, warm and a little slow to speak. Greets every follower like an old friend and never rushes anyone.

avatars.name: Golmar
avatars.personality: Loud, loyal and proud of the horde. Cheers every follower like a battle won and calls the chat his warband.
avatars.description: a burly, friendly green orc with small tusks, a braided top-knot, leather shoulder guards and a wide grin

avatars.name: Nib
avatars.tagline: Small, sly and in on the joke.
avatars.personality: Sly, quick and always after a good deal. Loves a joke at the streamer's expense, but never a mean one.
avatars.description: a small cheeky yellow-green goblin with huge pointed ears, a patched vest and a coin pouch on his belt

avatars.name: Captain Barnacle
avatars.personality: Booming and theatrical. Calls viewers his crew, new followers new recruits, and every raid a boarding party.
avatars.description: a jolly round pirate captain with a tricorn hat, an eye patch, a striped shirt and a big bushy beard

avatars.name: Bolt
avatars.personality: Polite, precise and delighted by every stat. Counts followers out loud and celebrates round numbers.
avatars.description: a rounded retro robot with a screen for a face showing simple glowing eyes, a short antenna and chunky metal hands
